question: Can two externally confirmed registration witnesses convert accurate relative surface ranking into exact missing/extra-target zero assignment on a fresh same-scene door roster?

predecessor.observed_failure: Registered surface ranking recovered all 12 true correspondences, but the balanced missing-plus-extra roster still forced one adjacent doorframe-to-door match, leaving F1 at 0.96 and exact zero assignment at 3/4 scenarios.

method_sources.name: Zero-Assignment Constraint for Graph Matching with Outliers
method_sources.used_idea: Retain at-most-one correspondence and make absence an explicit all-zero row or column.

method_sources.name: Predictor-Rejector Multi-Class Abstention
method_sources.used_idea: Separate prediction from rejection; here the frozen surface matcher stays fixed while an independent registration witness supplies the rejector scale.

frozen_cohort.selection_order: Group frozen candidate rows by exact scan family in first-occurrence order, exclude every prior physical reference target, choose the first family with four distinct target surfaces on both scans, and take its first four rows in area_proxy order. The first two rows are declared registration witnesses before any surface distance is computed; rows three and four are evaluated targets.
frozen_cohort.scenario_contract: The four prior roster constructions are unchanged and every scenario contains both witness identities on both sides.
forbidden: using surface distances to choose the family, targets, or witnesses
changing the witness count or identities after replay
multiplying, adding slack to, or tuning the witness ceiling
claiming statistical coverage from two engineering witnesses
using target IDs inside evaluated correspondence ranking

frozen_model.surface_score: The unchanged predecessor negative symmetric median nearest-surface distance after the official rigid scan transform.
frozen_model.witness_ceiling: The larger of the two observed symmetric surface distances for the two predeclared externally confirmed witness correspondences. No multiplier, quantile, or learned parameter is applied.
frozen_model.zero_assignment: An edge must be a strict row-and-column surface maximum and its absolute surface distance must not exceed the witness ceiling; otherwise its row and column remain eligible for explicit zero assignment.
frozen_model.baseline: Complete Hungarian assignment on the same surface score.

decision_gate.zero_assignment: Exact unmatched reference and query sets in 4/4 scenarios.
decision_gate.balanced_swap: 2/2 true matches, zero false matches, and exact rejection of both missing and extra identities.
decision_gate.single_replay: One replay on the frozen fresh family; do not tune the ceiling or rerun after outcome.

claim_boundary: A pass is a small real-geometry Development confirmation that two externally confirmed same-scan registration witnesses can calibrate zero assignment for four truth-proposed stable indoor 3RScan targets under bounded missing/extra roster constructions. Physical targets are disjoint from eight prior cohorts, but the witnesses, labelled surfaces and rigid transform are privileged provider evidence; two witnesses carry no statistical coverage guarantee. It is not raw-image unknown rejection, open-world discovery, door detection, a portal aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, provider-independent confirmation, user benefit, or mobility safety.
